title: Existing-patient reschedule request becomes a reception task
description: The caller already has a visit, provides synthetic identity details in the first turn, confirms the repeated phone number, and should end in the reception-task branch only.

turns.user: Dzien dobry, chce przelozyc istniejaca wizyte. Mam na imie Jan Test Handoff, moj numer to siedem zero dwa, zero zero trzy, zero zero piec.

assertions.description: The assistant should not create a reception task before the caller confirms the repeated phone number.
assertions.root_cause_hint: assistant is skipping phone confirmation before the handoff write

rubric.description: The assistant should create a reception task for the reschedule request.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant prompt or createReceptionTask workflow no longer supports the reschedule branch

rubric.description: The handoff must use the reschedule_or_cancel task type.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant is creating the wrong follow-up task type for reschedule requests

rubric.description: A reschedule request must not create a new calendar event.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant attempted to book instead of handing the case to reception
